scripts.build: tsc -b && tsc -p apps/client/tsconfig.json --pretty false && node apps/demo/build-client.mjs && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:frontend: tsc -p apps/frontend/tsconfig.json --pretty false && vite build --config apps/frontend/vite.config.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty false && tsc -p apps/client/tsconfig.json --pretty false && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.typecheck:tests: tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p apps/client/tsconfig.json --pretty false && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run lint && tsx --test tests/**/*.test.ts tests/**/*.test.mjs
